title: Avenyou drops a groovy rebellion with sonic blaze ‘Ashtray (Why Don’t You?)’
htmlContent:
Avenyou is making a strong comeback with his latest track, "Ashtray (Why Don't You?)," filled with attitude, cleverness, and a beat that keeps you moving. This song captures a whole vibe, an energetic expression wrapped in a catchy sound.

The bass is thumping, the drums are lively, and the vocals draw you in, making everyone want to dance. That's the effect it has, and the rhythm propels it forward. Avenyou's singing is equally captivating, smooth, and packed with a playful, cheeky attitude. Created entirely in Avenyou's home studio, humorously named Creepyville, "Ashtray (Why Don't You?)" has a raw, genuine feel that is rebellious.

https://open.spotify.com/track/1FQX2JciMEqL3SSH4INyb1?si=wjZ1SSkSRlOYzNkqswiSdg

The production, expertly done by William Zegglis of The Rubens, gives the song a clean, modern sound while keeping its fresh, DIY spirit. The words resonate with a mix of lightheartedness and pointed commentary, turning everyday observations into memorable lines. "Ashtray (Why Don't You?)" stands out as a celebration of freedom and fun. Avenyou has created something unique and rebellious, proving he knows how to make music that goes against the grain.
